crossRefs.note: Hear this, all you peoples. Listen, all you inhabitants of the world,
Come near, you nations, to hear! Listen, you peoples. Let the earth and all it contains hear, the world, and everything…
‘Hear this now, foolish people without understanding, who have eyes, and don’t see, who have ears, and don’t hear:
“Listen to this, you priests! Listen, house of Israel, and give ear, house of the king! For the judgment is against…
Hear this word that Yahweh has spoken against you, children of Israel, against the whole family which I brought up out…
Listen to this word, you cows of Bashan, who are on the mountain of Samaria, who oppress the poor, who crush the needy…
Listen to this word which I take up for a lamentation over you, O house of Israel.
Hear, you peoples, all of you. Listen, O earth, and all that is therein: and let the Lord Yahweh be witness against…
I said, “Please listen, you heads of Jacob, and rulers of the house of Israel: Isn’t it for you to know justice?
Please listen to this, you heads of the house of Jacob, and rulers of the house of Israel, who abhor justice, and…
He who has ears to hear, let him hear.”
He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the assemblies. To him who overcomes I will give to eat from…
“Please inquire of past generations. Find out about the learning of their fathers.
With aged men is wisdom, in length of days understanding.
With us are both the gray-headed and the very aged men, much elder than your father.
“Why do the wicked live, become old, yes, and grow mighty in power?
A day of darkness and gloominess, a day of clouds and thick darkness. As the dawn spreading on the mountains, a great…
For ask now of the days that are past, which were before you, since the day that God created man on the earth, and from…
Yahweh will bring on you, on your people, and on your father’s house, days that have not come, from the day that…
Alas! for that day is great, so that none is like it. It is even the time of Jacob’s trouble; but he will be saved out…
“At that time Michael will stand up, the great prince who stands for the children of your people; and there will be a…
for then there will be great suffering, such as has not been from the beginning of the world until now, no, nor ever…

translations.web: Hear this, you elders, And listen, all you inhabitants of the land. Has this ever happened in your days, or in the days of your fathers?
translations.bsb: Hear this, O elders; and give ear, all who dwell in the land. Has anything like this ever happened in your days or in the days of your fathers?
translations.kjv: Hear this, ye old men, and give ear, all ye inhabitants of the land. Hath this been in your days, or even in the days of your fathers?
translations.asv: Hear this, ye old men, and give ear, all ye inhabitants of the land. Hath this been in your days, or in the days of your fathers?
